column1: # Certified FloatAP sqrt oracle (D83), exact arithmetic only.
# precision_bits mode input_num input_den expected_num expected_den
# Input is the correctly nearest-even-rounded positive Rational used by the original test.
# 5 precisions x (14 input rationals plus 4 shifted operands) x 4 modes: 360 original checks.
# Duplicate rounded inputs are deduplicated; all original checks still execute.
# Verify q^2*B <= A < (q+1)^2*B (integer square root floor).
# Nearest: compare 4*A to (2*q+1)^2*B; ties-to-even. Directed: exact iff A=q^2*B.
# Result q*2^e, canonical rational. No FloatAP, FloatMP, GMP or MPFR required.
